text:
Olivia (Sales): Quick intro — Alex from EdgeFjord is ready to start the joint POC. They want a shared pilot tenant, SSO (SAML), VPC egress rules, and telemetry export for usage-based billing. Can eng + infra triage technical asks?
Alex (EdgeFjord): Thanks Olivia — want to validate SSO + VPC before we spin up real traffic. Also need guidance on estimated token costs for a 2-week trial (approx 100k reqs/day, avg 300 tokens/request).
Sam (Eng-Platform): Looping in platform. Two quick Qs: what model size do you want to serve (gpt-medium, gpt-large, custom fine-tune)? And are responses streamed or batch?
Alex (EdgeFjord): We'll start with gpt-large equivalent, no streaming for the POC. Latency target ~200ms p95.
Marta (Eng-Infra): For VPC egress we need their egress CIDRs and SSO IdP metadata. We can offer a demo tenant in our staging region with a peered VPC. Proposed minimal network allowlist: 
```
- Redwood egress IPs: 34.82.10.0/24, 34.82.11.0/24
- Partner CIDR: X.X.X.X/24 (to be provided)
```
Jess (Partnerships): On pricing — do they want a short reserved commit or strictly usage-based? Olivia, what did EdgeFjord ask?
Olivia (Sales): They prefer usage-based but might convert to a short reserved for guaranteed throughput. For the POC they only need predictable cost guidance. Can we give an estimate for the two-week run?
Sam (Eng-Platform): Ballpark: with gpt-large and 100k reqs/day @300 tokens -> ~30M tokens/day. With our hosted pricing ~0.0006 $/token (example rate) -> approx $18k/day, so ~$252k for two weeks. If we enable batching + KV caching we can likely cut 30-50%. We should run a perf sim.
Raj (Solutions): I'll own the perf sim and batching suggestions. I'll need a sample workload and a representative prompt set from Alex. Alex, can you drop a small sample corpus?
Alex (EdgeFjord): Uploading sample payloads to the shared drive now. Also, one item: security questionnaire — they require answers for KMS, audit logs, and data residency for EU customers.
Marta (Eng-Infra): For KMS we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments; hosted can use provider-managed KMS with export logs. For the POC we can provide audit logs to their SIEM endpoint via syslog/HTTPS. Need to know whether they need HSM-backed keys.
Jess (Partnerships): I'll compile the security questionnaire answers. Can someone paste the short KMS / audit bullets I can reuse?
Sam (Eng-Platform): Paste for Jess: 
- KMS: Redwood integrates with AWS KMS/GCP KMS via customer master keys; Private supports HSM.
- Audit logs: Token-level request logs and model routing logs available, exportable to S3/HTTPS/Syslog.
- Data residency: Hosted regions EU/US available; Private/VPC deployment available for strict residency.
Marta (Eng-Infra): Network runbook snippet for tenant provisioning (for Raj):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"name":"edgefjord-poc","region":"eu-west-1","allowed_cidrs":["PARTNER_CIDR"]}'
```
Olivia (Sales): Can we get an internal estimate for runbook time (SSO + VPC + tenant + telemetry) — quick guess?
Marta (Eng-Infra): SSO config + test: 1 day. VPC peering & firewall rules: 1 day (depends on partner NetOps). Tenant provisioning & KMS: 0.5 day. Telemetry hook + billing export: 0.5 day. So ~3 working days if no blockers.
Raj (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow to collect prompts, sample traffic, and clarify SLAs. Who wants to join? @Sam @Marta @Jess
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll be there to scope perf tests.
Jess (Partnerships): I'll join and capture enablement checklist for the partner.
Alex (EdgeFjord): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. I'll send the NetOps contact and the IdP metadata before EOD.
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: "EdgeFjord POC kickoff" — 2024-06-12 10:00 UTC.
Olivia (Sales): Great — I'll create a GH runbook page with these notes and assign follow-ups. Will ping once done. :thumbsup:
Alex (EdgeFjord): Looking forward.
